title: Took vg-paradigms release 2026.10.22 by its auto subscription
body:
The dry run broke nothing: no rule it would newly break, no license it would block. What moved:
- + deps.pinned: A dependency on another of your projects is pinned in what's committed: a released version, a git tag or a revision, never a path to a sibling checkout. To develop two projects together, override it locally and uncommitted (Cargo's `[patch]` in your own .cargo/config.toml, a flake's `--override-input`, `bun link`). The dependency is a subscription: its releases arrive as that project's subscription says, and moving the pin runs this project's checks first.
